question: Compared with the frozen 162-bar cap, do 270/540/810 observed 5-minute bars (approximately 5/10/15 complete 54-bar sessions) improve original Technical V2-B outcomes?

bar_time_semantics.timeout_counter: observed 5-minute bars since entry; overnight/non-trading time does not increment the counter
bar_time_semantics.day_equivalence: max_hold_bars / 54 is a complete-session equivalent; intraday entry and next-bar-open exit mean it is not guaranteed to exit exactly at the Nth session close
bar_time_semantics.cross_day_measure: number of observed trading-date transitions between actual entry-open and exit-open; inclusive session count is transitions + 1

all_other_settings: Frozen Technical V2-B entry, 30-bar low technical exit, market proxy, Risk V1 except max holding cap, capital, sizing, fees, tax, slippage, minimum hold, cooldown, daily entry limit, data eligibility and next-tradable-open execution remain identical.

execution.share_sizing: Risk V1 helper capped by existing engine quantity and affordable cash; integer shares

market_regime_filter.complete_session: 09:00-13:25, exactly 54 five-minute bars for all five frozen universe stocks

data_eligibility: Frozen Technical V2-B global intersection; all five proxy-universe stocks have exactly 54 real 09:00-13:25 bars on each included day; EXCLUDE_NO_FILL; no fills or synthetic bars.
decision_rule: Exploratory comparison only; do not select by net return alone. A 1-4 trade result is INSUFFICIENT. Adoption requires adequate samples and coherent improvement in net performance, PF, drawdown, exit outcomes, and across-year stability; otherwise retain frozen 162-bar version.
